input.question: If Germany wasn't a country at the time, how come Martin Luther was considered German? What nationality would he have been considered at the time?
input.ground_truth: Germanic was an ethnic group long before the company of Germany was formed. Germany is really just the latest iteration in a chain of German countries in that area of the world. The Holy Roman Empire was the first "germany", but even before that the Romans would refer to that part of the world as Germania.
